blurb:
Upon arrival, get ready to explore the world-famous NASA Johnson Space Center, home of astronaut training and historic space missions.

With your included admission ticket, you’ll discover interactive exhibits, marvel at real spacecraft, and even touch a rock from the Moon!

Don’t miss the chance to step inside a replica of the Space Shuttle and see the massive Saturn V rocket that powered America to the Moon.

This tour is the perfect blend of convenience and discovery—no need to worry about driving or parking, just pure excitement from start to finish.

Whether you’re a lifelong space enthusiast or simply curious about what’s beyond our world, this tour guarantees an out-of-this-world experience.
